task_description: Rename a project owned by a given user.
Look up a user's profile by username.
Return the top N scores of a game.
Fetch the latest readings for a numeric sensor id.
Read the department name stored on an employee record and look up that department's manager.
Return the price history for a stock ticker symbol.
Archive messages older than a given number of days.
Search orders by an optional status, customer name and start date.
Convert a price in cents to a display string.
Sort the product list by a caller-chosen column and direction.
